text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api queue growth detected in us-west-1. queue length +11k over 10m, p95 ~3.8s, p99 ~12.4s. GPU pool hosted-us-west-1 at 100% alloc. autoscaler failed to create new instances 5m ago. tagging as SEV2.

alex (oncall): seeing it, joining. checking dashboard now.

nina (infra): reprovisioner logs show repeated failures: 
```
provisioner: error creating instance: quotaExceeded: Your project has insufficient GPU quota in region us-west-1
request id: req-0a1b2c
```

alex (oncall): autoscaler timeline? when did it stop succeeding?

andre (runtime): autoscaler made scale requests at 1728003600 and 1728003660, cloud return 403 quota. fallback routing to smaller models attempted but backlog already grew. KV cache pressure high.

maya (support): we have 3 customer reports of timeouts (prod requests return 504) starting ~ 1728003500. CS is triaging impacted tenants list.

alex (oncall): immediate mitigations to try: 1) enable per-tenant emergency rate limit 2) turn on model-fallback for hosted API (route to quantized v-small) 3) drain non-critical batch jobs in that region 4) request manual reserve pool / spot override. I can flip rate limit.

nina (infra): creating emergency "reserve-gpu" pool is a manual console action. I'll request manual allocation but expect ~10-20m lead time. Opening cloud support ticket now.

ops-bot: Cloud ticket created: TICKET-19483. Quota increase requested for 20 GPUs in us-west-1. ETA: pending.

andre (runtime): pushing a config to route 20% of traffic to hosted-eu fallback pool to relieve us-west. Will flip `routing.policy.region_preference` to reduce new requests hitting us-west for noisy tenants.

alex (oncall): doing per-tenant rate limit for top noisy tenant IDs: tenant-113, tenant-204, tenant-999. Setting burst=50, sustained=10 qps.

maya (support): notifying affected customers via status/incident channel. Posting initial message to status page: "Degraded performance for hosted API in US-WEST due to GPU provisioning failures. Engineers working on mitigation."

nina (infra): manual reserve attempt failed once due to orphaned lease: `leaseOwnerConflict`. Trying cleanup then reapply. Logs: 
```
lease-manager: release lease kube-node-317 failed: conflict
```

andre (runtime): starting immediate model-fallback rollout: quantized-vsmall -> attach cache warmers. This should drop p99 by ~40-50% for most requests. Rolling in 2m.

alex (oncall): prep for signal when backlog < 2k and p99 < 1.5s. If not trending down in 20m, we escalate to oncall-ops for manual cloud capacity.

ops-bot: Reserve pool request succeeded: RESERVE-782. 8 GPUs allocated as hot reserve (not enough to fully catch up).

liam (sre-night): I'll take handoff in 30m. current plan ok. please leave runbook steps in thread + any cloud ticket IDs.

nina (infra): cloud support responded: quota increase may take up to 2 hours for approval. they offered transient quota via emergency pool for 2h if we accept cost override. Need approval from finance/exec.

alex (oncall): do it. prioritize availability over cost. maya, flag sales/customer-success for high-touch tenants we may throttle.

maya (support): pinged sales + cs slack. informing top 5 customers directly.

andre (runtime): applied routing changes. new traffic distribution: us-west 70% -> 40%, eu fallback 30% -> 60% for eligible requests. Initial telemetry shows request rate to us-west down 35%. backlog growth slowed.

alex (oncall): p95 now 2.1s, p99 6.5s. queue length 6.8k (down from 11k). good progress but still degraded.

ops-bot: emergency cloud quota accepted by finance override. Cloud temporary quota granted +20 GPUs for 2h.

nina (infra): provisioning new instances now. `kubectl get nodes` shows new nodes joining (3/20 so far).

alex (oncall): starting staged drain of legacy batch job namespace `batch-ingest-usw` to free 4 GPUs ASAP.

andre (runtime): cache warmers running, model-fallback latencies look stable. Applying KV cache window to 512 for v-small to avoid cache thrash.

maya (support): status update posted: "Mitigation in progress. Traffic rerouted and emergency capacity requested. Some customers may experience intermittent 5-10s latency or timeouts."

liam (sre-night): taking over active pager. Summary: queue peaked +11k, autoscaler failed on quota, emergency reserve +20 GPUs approved, routing + fallback applied, backlog reduced to 6.8k, p99 6.5s. Handing to night shift for follow-up and cleanup.

alex (oncall): notes in runbook: ticket TICKET-19483, reserve RESERVE-782, cloud transient quota ID: CLOUD-TR-552, actions taken: per-tenant rate limits, region routing shift, model-fallback roll, batch drains.

nina (infra): will monitor new node join rate and provisioner errors. if provisioning stalls again, we need to open escalation to cloud-account-team.

liam (sre-night): ack. I'll keep thread as primary comms channel overnight. please escalate if anything regresses.

maya (support): prepping customer followups for morning after impact window. will provide list of impacted tenants in #customer-impact.

ops-bot: Auto-note: incident severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1728007800 based on reduced customer impact.

liam (sre-night): quick checklist for morning: 1) confirm quota permanent increase or release transient 2) revert emergency routing gradually 3) re-enable standard autoscaler policies 4) schedule postmortem and RCA owners.

alex (oncall): thanks team. handing off.
__note: All values are strings or list of strings per agents.md requirements. Thread is single continuous string with messages in chronological order.
